name: Chad Boulton
summary: Principal Software Engineer with 25 years of experience building enterprise SaaS applications, modern web platforms, and cloud-native systems. Strong frontend-leaning full-stack engineer with deep expertise in React, .NET, AWS, and modern application architecture. Experienced leading technical direction, mentoring engineers, modernizing legacy systems, designing scalable micro-frontend and microservice architectures, and delivering polished, high-performance user experiences. Passionate about elegant software design, developer productivity, AI-assisted development, and solving complex technical problems while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.
must_haves: Remote or Salt Lake Valley location
dealbreakers: Legacy-only technology stacks with no modernization efforts
location_preference: Remote preferred. Also open to hybrid or onsite opportunities within the Salt Lake Valley, Utah. Not willing to relocate.

desired_compensation.preferred_compensation: Competitive salary and total compensation appropriate for a Principal Software Engineer.

education.degree: Bachelor's degree coursework in Computer Engineering (3 years completed, no degree earned)

notes: Strong preference for remaining a hands-on engineer rather than transitioning into people management. Particularly interested in challenging technical problems involving distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, developer productivity, enterprise architecture, and modern frontend engineering. Enjoys owning technical direction, mentoring engineers, modernizing legacy applications, and building polished products with excellent user experiences.
